public.installSubtitle: On your home screen in seconds — no App Store needed.
public.installIntro: IronBandit is a Progressive Web App (PWA): you can add it to your phone straight from the browser like a normal app — it runs full-screen, loads fast and tolerates being offline.
public.installHint: After installing, just open IronBandit from the home-screen icon — like any other app.

landing.heroTitle: Train with a plan. See your progress.
landing.heroText: IronBandit is a free workout log for strength and fitness training. Create your own exercises and training plans, track every set with weight and reps live at the gym, and keep an eye on your progress.
landing.feat1Text: Assemble plans like “Push Day” from your exercises: create once, reuse anytime. Training plans can be exported and imported as CSV.
landing.feat2Text: Log every set with weight and reps live during your workout, optimized for the numeric keypad on phones. Just swipe to the next exercise.
landing.feat3Text: Volume, personal records and weekly goals are calculated and visualized automatically.
landing.feat4Text: Your full training history and body weight, viewable and editable at any time.
landing.installCta: Install as an app on your phone
landing.feat5Text: Missing an exercise? Add it yourself in one tap (name, muscle group, category, image). It joins the shared exercise database visible to everyone.
landing.crossText: My nutrition tracker — keep calories & macros in view.
landing.howSubtitle: From plan to progress in four simple steps.
landing.how1Text: Group exercises into a day, e.g. “Push Day”. Just selection and order, no weights or sets here.
landing.how2Text: Pick from the pre-filled exercise database or create your own exercises with an image.
landing.how3Text: Open the plan, tap an exercise and log set by set live. Swipe to the next exercise while the screen stays awake.
landing.how4Text: History, personal records and charts at a glance, plus a weekly overview and an automatic hint when an exercise stalls.
landing.b1Title: A log, not scraps of paper
landing.b1Text: All workouts neatly in one place. No more paper or Excel chaos.
landing.b2Text: New personal bests are detected and highlighted automatically.
landing.b3Text: Follow your weight trend and training volume visually.
landing.b4Text: Pre-filled exercises with images, or add your own anytime.
landing.b5Text: Installable as a PWA: always at hand during training and offline-tolerant.
landing.b6Text: Log your weight, track the trend. All data editable anytime.
landing.b7Text: See at a glance how many workouts and how much volume you got done this week, including a comparison to last week.
landing.b8Text: IronBandit automatically flags when an exercise hasn't progressed for weeks.
landing.b9Text: The screen stays awake during your workout. No annoying unlocking between sets.
landing.b10Text: Note how each exercise felt. The note stays with it in your history.
landing.featuresHeadline: Everything for training — nothing on top
landing.featuresSub: From training plan to progress curve: IronBandit covers the whole path at the gym.
landing.feat6Text: Log your body weight and follow the trend as a chart, right next to your training.
landing.benefitsSub: Why IronBandit makes your training simpler and more visible.
landing.installBannerText: Add it to your phone — offline-tolerant and always at hand.

rest.settingsInfo: Default rest duration for the rest timer. Stored per account and used automatically next time you train. You can still adjust it on the fly during a workout.
rest.notifyInfo: Shows a phone notification when the rest timer ends. A paired smartwatch (Garmin, Apple Watch, Wear OS, …) vibrates along. Applies to this device.
rest.notifyWatchHint: Vibration length and strength are set on the watch or in its app. The watch app (e.g. Garmin Connect) must allow notifications from your browser / IronBandit.
rest.notifyTestBody: This is how the rest end is announced – does your watch vibrate?
rest.notifyTestSent: Test sent – check phone and watch.
rest.notifyTestFailed: Test failed – notifications are blocked on this device.
rest.notifyDenied: Notifications are blocked for IronBandit. Allow them in your browser/phone settings, then enable here.
rest.notifyUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
rest.notifyIosHint: On iPhone this only works in the installed app: Share → “Add to Home Screen”, then open IronBandit from there.
